These public-source snapshots were fetched on 2026-09-09 using bounded reads.
They are deterministic parser regression inputs, not browser acceptance evidence.

- NTNU MTDT cohort 2026: public `studyplan` JSON discovered from https://www.ntnu.no/studier/studieplan; fetched 09:43 Europe/Oslo.
- INN BAPEDD cohort 2026: https://studiekatalog.edutorium.no/inn/nb/program/BAPEDD/2026; fetched 09:40 Europe/Oslo.
- DMMH BEMNER cohort 2026: https://studier.dmmh.no/nb/program/BEMNER/2026; fetched 09:40 Europe/Oslo.
- HVL: https://www.hvl.no/studier/studieprogram/grunnskolelaerer-1-7-sogndal/2026h/utdanningsplan/; fetched 09:57 Europe/Oslo.

Source HTML is parsed as data. Referenced scripts are never evaluated or fetched.

Additional bounded public reads on 2026-09-12 (Europe/Oslo):

- MF: `mf-professional-current.html` from https://mf.no/studier/programmer/profesjonsstudium-teologi and `mf-catalogue-outgoing.html` from https://mf.no/studier/programmer?open=2. `mf-lektor-current.html` and `mf-catalogue-current.html` reuse the saved 2026-09-09 Lektorprogram and catalogue responses. The catalogue fixture also preserves the source's published `open` radio filters, which occur outside `main`.
- HLT: `hlt-batl-current.html` and `hlt-bala-current.html` retain headings and study-model sections from https://hlt.no/batl/ and https://hlt.no/bala/.
- LDH: `ldh-bis26.html` from https://ldh.no/studietilbud/bachelor-i-sykepleie/emnerBIS/emnerBIS26. The `ldh-*-pdf-metadata.json` fixtures preserve metadata excerpts, original PDF page numbers and labelled table rows extracted locally with PDF.js from the H2026 PDFs linked by https://ldh.no/studietilbud/masterstudier/master-i-avansert-klinisk-operasjonssykepleie-makop, https://ldh.no/studietilbud/masterstudier/master-i-avansert-klinisk-allmennsykepleie and https://ldh.no/studietilbud/videreutdanninger/videreutdanning-i-barselomsorg. Source sizes were respectively 3,971,339, 4,572,775 and 1,383,526 bytes. The MAKOP fixture deliberately preserves the source conflict for MOPSY-200 (table semester 2, course metadata semester 1). MAL metadata crosses page boundaries and contains an elective appendix; its table-of-contents mention must not make earlier courses elective.
- Fjellhaug: `fih-studies.html`, `fih-btfl.html`, `fih-ateol.html`, `fih-mtm.html` from https://fih.fjellhaug.no/studier, https://fih.fjellhaug.no/studier/teologi-formidling-og-ledelse-bachelor, https://fih.fjellhaug.no/studier/ateol and https://fih.fjellhaug.no/studier/mtm. Fixtures retain source tables, nested cells, repeated link fragments and open electives.
- Ansgar: `ansgar-calendar.html` preserves the tables from https://www.ansgarhoyskole.no/student/kalender. The source names 23 programme/study-year rows, including shared first-year rows, for autumn 2026 and spring 2027. These are not 23 distinct degrees. General deadlines and the separate master tempo table remain distinguishable from course-semester rows.
- Barratt Due: `barrattdue-*.html` preserve the published category links under https://barrattdue.no/studier/hoyere-utdanning/, the linked instrumental, vocal, master and PPU annual plans, the music-didactics page explicitly under revision, and https://barrattdue.no/studier/hoyere-utdanning/bachelor-i-utovende-musikk/valgemner/. Annual plans do not establish a calendar semester or student cohort. The elective fixture preserves the distinct 2026–2027 and 2025–2026 offerings. `barrattdue-plandisc.json` contains three selected public activities from the public API used by the institution's published https://create.plandisc.com/wheel/showPublic/EJuyq2e link; account, attendee and author metadata are omitted. Its stale display window deliberately differs from the actual event dates. These are general institution activities, not a personal teaching timetable.
- BAS: `bas-programme.html` retains the programme heading and public PDF links from https://bas.org/en/master-i-arkitektur/. Its thirty dated master-course titles span autumn 2020 to spring 2025; their calendar editions must not be inferred from the PDF upload-directory dates. `bas-general-typography.json` retains actual heading weight, size, geometry, duration and section markers extracted locally with PDF.js from the linked https://bas.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/General-course-catalogue-1-2-and-3-year-BAS.doc.pdf (seven pages). Unneeded prose is replaced with an explicit omission marker while retaining the paragraph boundary. This general catalogue is not a dated cohort edition. APP/DAV/TRIP are subject areas, not published course codes; credit values are absent. Third-year additional courses have no semester placement.
- HØFY calendars: `hfy-calendar-sources.html` retains all five dated class-plan links from https://hfy.no/for-studenter. The matching `hfy-calendar-*.json` fixtures preserve actual PDF text and source coordinates from those public links, read locally with PDF.js. They deliberately retain wrong or contradictory years, repeated gathering numbers, a wrong week number, end dates before start dates, unpublished deadlines and Oslo A class labels inside the Oslo B file. The adapter must expose these as unresolved source rows, without choosing a corrected date or class. These source reads and deterministic tests are separate from confirmation of the full browser flow.
- KRUS PDFs: `krus-*-versions.html` preserves the dated study-plan links on the three public pages beneath https://www.krus.no/for-aspiranter-og-studenter. The six `krus-*-pdf.json` files preserve cover and course-table excerpts with original coordinates from every linked full-time cohort plan (H2024–V2026, H2025–V2027, H2026–V2028), the part-time V2026–H2028 plan, and the two bachelor-plan validity editions (through autumn 2026, from spring 2027). All six public PDFs were fetched once on 2026-09-12 and parsed locally. Bachelor validity dates do not establish student cohorts; its source table numbers the extension semesters 5–8 and does not name its elective offerings. Part-time source text splits `KRUS2300D` across adjacent PDF items; reconstruction must preserve the actual code.

The two `timeedit-{nmbu-math100,hvl-dat100}-2026.ics` files preserve existing public autumn-2026 calendar snapshots previously stored under `artifacts/public-*.ics`. The file-picker regression uses these durable fixtures, without making external requests. Their missing group metadata is intentional; they are historical captured-source tests, not live-source checks.

Only public programme information is included. These excerpts test source contracts; simulated transport and edited fixtures do not constitute a newly verified external browser import.
